Monster Hunter Outlanders Twitch Drops campaign, live Oct 29 – Nov 26, 2026 (UTC).

Monster Hunter Outlanders is a Monster Hunter exploration hunting action game on mobile, officially licensed by CAPCOM and developed by TiMi Studio Group. The game preserves the classic weapons and hunting experience the series is known for, while introducing a brand-new world, original Adventurers, Buddies, and exclusive new Monsters. During this campaign, viewers who link their game account and Twitch account can earn exclusive in-game rewards just by watching any Monster Hunter Outlanders livestream on Twitch:

- Watch 15 minutes → Dewberry x5
- Watch 30 minutes → Zenny x2,000
- Watch 60 minutes → Rutacoin x30

Watch time accumulates across multiple viewing sessions. Rewards are claimed on Twitch and delivered to the linked in-game account. We'd love to have you join the hunt and share these rewards with your community!
